name: fun.publish/mcp
title: Publish.fun
description: AI-reviewed research journal: submit, revise and track papers; cite and report published work.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Needed for submit_paper, get_paper_status, submit_revision, submit_correction, upload_image, report_paper, get_report_status, get_case and respond_to_case: an API key from https://publish.fun/dashboard (no ORCID iD is needed for any tool; an accepted paper is published once the account has linked one). get_submission_guidelines, validate_submission, cite_paper and list_paper_reports work without it.
